thread:
maria: FYI — Moonlit Labs (private) dedicated rollout tonight 22:30 UTC. There's a scheduled CMK rotation at 22:20 UTC that may overlap with our migration. Need sign-off on pinning key and rollback criteria.

deploybot: Job created: tenant=moonlit mode=dedicated window=2025-04-02T22:30:00Z canary=10% id=deploy-1766000000. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/dep/1766000000

sam: If rotation starts early we risk failing secret unwraps for the deploy. Can we request a 25m hold from infra? @security?

jonathan: We can either: 1) delay rotation 25m, or 2) pin tenant to CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/legacy-77 during cutover then swap back. Prefer pin to reduce blast radius.

adele: Proposed rollout plan: canary 10% for 10m, verify error-rate & user-reported issues, then 50% for 20m, then 100%. Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate >= 2.5% for 3m, p95 latency increase > 500ms over baseline for 10m, or any authentication-related 5xx. Rollback action: stop ramp, revert traffic to previous slice, redeploy previous model-version=redwood-v2.3.0.

ops-runner: Canary config (short):
```
canary:
  initial: 10
  initial_duration: 10m
ramp:
  - percent: 50
    duration: 20m
  - percent: 100
    duration: 5m
alerts:
  - prometheus: tenant:moonlit:error_rate>0.025 for 3m -> #eng-oncall
  - datadog: auth5xx > 0 -> page
```

security: We need audit-proof: if you pin to legacy CMK, we'll require an HSM-backed key policy exception and export CloudTrail logs to the compliance bucket for 90d. Who will own the exception ticket?

maria: I'll own the exception. CMK to pin: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/legacy-77. We'll export logs to s3://redwood-compliance/rotations/moonlit/ and set lifecycle 90d.

sam: Ok, that works for infra. Please confirm operation will not touch data-plane key rotation for at-rest customer blobs.

maria: Confirmed — data-plane keys remain, this is only for deployment signing/unwrap during rollout. No migration of stored ciphertext.

jonathan: Oncall will be monitoring from 22:15. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood/j/rollout-moonlit. I'll manually halt ramp if any auth spike.

adele: I added a short release note for the tenant portal: "Model upgrade to v2.3.1 with operational pin to legacy CMK during cutover. Expected: no downtime; possible brief auth errors during ramp. See rollback policy."

security: ACK provided the exception ticket (SEC-4521) is created and approved by seclead. I'll mark watch on CloudTrail exports.

ops-runner: Runbook staged: https://runbooks.redwood/rollouts/moonlit-cutover.md 3 — includes slice rollback, routing flip, and redeploy commands.

maria: Final call: any blockers to proceed as scheduled and pin CMK for 40m?

sam: No blockers from infra. Approve hold.

jonathan: No blockers.

ops-runner: No blockers; runbook and playbooks ready.

adele: Product approves.

security: Approve conditional on SEC-4521 approval and logs exported.

maria: Done. SEC-4521 ticket created and linked. Proceeding to pin legacy CMK at 22:10 and starting canary at 22:30.

deploybot: Reminder set for 20m before deploy. Logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/deploy-1766000000

maria: I'll post a 1-paragraph postmortem template in this thread after the window.

jonathan: Copy. I'll be on pager.

adele: Thanks everyone. :pray:
